title: Events
page_subtitle: Join us for inspiring gatherings, workshops, and community activities
overview_text_1: At Mary Gold, we believe in the power of bringing people together to learn, share, and grow. Our events create meaningful opportunities for connection, collaboration, and positive change.
overview_text_2: From workshops and seminars to community gatherings and advocacy campaigns, our events are designed to inspire, educate, and empower young people to make a difference.
overview_text_3: While we're currently planning our next round of events, we invite you to stay connected and be part of our growing community.
upcoming_subtitle: Mark your calendar for these exciting opportunities
upcoming_empty_text: We're currently planning our next round of workshops, seminars, and community gatherings. Our team is working hard to bring you meaningful experiences that will inspire and empower.
upcoming_empty_text_2: Check back soon or subscribe to our newsletter to be the first to know about upcoming events.
past_subtitle: Highlights from our previous gatherings and activities
past_empty_text: We're in the process of documenting our past events to share the impact and stories from our journey.
past_empty_text_2: Soon you'll be able to browse through photos, testimonials, and highlights from our previous events.
newsletter_text: Subscribe to our newsletter and be the first to know about upcoming events, program updates, and opportunities.
